final_architecture.name: Serverless #2 (Unmanaged)
final_architecture.design_rationale: Serverless functions around Message, Presence, Conversation workflows with managed data and cache layers. Auto-scales to zero during idle periods and pay-per-use pricing; cold starts and vendor lock-in are trade-offs.
